$comment: MF-42 (FE-31; plan.min cut 5, P42-D9 a): the one data home of the binding boundary. libraries = the MaxBLD-new UI packages (one tier); they may be imported only by a listed binding module, a listed provider, a test file or the vendor dir. A converted surface's mount file (mounts[]) may import only a framework package (framework[]), a binding module or a project-internal path (mount_internal[], relative paths included), never a UI library or any other package. modules[] are exact .tsx files under the R-13 component roots, each owned by a promoted platform_shared census entry (promoted_entries[]). ref_kinds and non_display_keys judge golden props (SV-SBIND); widget_types judges render.form (SV-DESC). Shape: screen-data.schema.json#/definitions/bindings. Read by scripts/surfaces/screen-checks.mjs and the FE-31 and FE-05 locks. Dated note 2026-11-09 (MF-37; D-23, ~/Buildo-scratch/DECISIONS-PREAPPROVED-20261108.md): mapping.web is the closed list of JSX element names each web binding module may render per archetype (FE-31 C-8); RJSF's Mantine theme renders FileInput, NumberInput, TextInput, Select and the submit Button itself, so those names document what a FORM shows rather than JSX in our modules. touch_targets.web lists the Mantine size values that reach 44 px (FE-31 C-9), measured from @mantine/core 9.8.0: inputs and Button lg 50 px, xl 60 px; CloseButton and ActionIcon lg 34 px, xl 44 px. ref_kinds gains contract (FE-32): a golden value {"contract": "<contract_id>.<field>"} names a field of a CONTRACT descriptor's inputs.field_whitelist. Dated note 2026-11-09 (MF-37; operator "a, 1-3 approved"): the web library is Mantine 8.3.18 / mantine-datatable 8.3.13; the touch_targets values were re-measured on @mantine/core 8.3.18 styles.css (--button-height-lg and --input-height-lg 3.125rem, xl 3.75rem; --cb-size-xl and --ai-size-xl 2.75rem = 44 px) and are unchanged. Dated note 2026-11-10 (MF-35; the binding standard, Spec 126 §11b.2 dated note 2026-11-10 item (5); plan ~/Buildo-scratch/mcfrontend/MF-35/plan.v3.md §2): the first mobile binding. modules gains mobile/src/components/surfaces/SurfaceRenderer.tsx and SearchBinding.tsx (archetype SEARCH, owner shared_mobile_surface_binding, promoted); mounts gains the search screen; mount_internal gains @/hooks/ and @/store/ (the screen reads the lookup hook and the recent-searches store); edges is the safe-area EdgeRecord {top: additive}, equal to the legacy edges [top] (an array of strings under a non-display key reads as display text to SV-SBIND); ref_kinds gains derived (P35-D14 a: a declared deviation with a closed list of names, checked by the mobile golden test); non_display_keys gains the React Native prop names that carry no display text (measured with SV-SBIND on the goldens). mapping.mobile.SEARCH is the closed component table of SurfaceRenderer.tsx: its COMPONENTS literal has exactly these keys, each an imported library part (FE-31 C-8 mobile half). touch_targets.mobile names the className token that reaches 44 px on Button and Input: NativeWind's rem is 14 here, so min-h-11 is 38.5 px and only min-h-[44px] is 44 (plan v2 F-A; FE-31 C-9 mobile half). Dated note 2026-11-10 (MF-40; operator, verbatim: "y recommendation: C, with the four trims. approved"; plan delta 1 section 3 item 5 and S3): mapping.web.FORM gains Textarea and DateInput, which RJSF's Mantine theme renders for the offer form's textarea and date widgets (documentation of what a FORM shows, as for the other RJSF names; no Checkbox: trim 4). mounts gain the admin placements page files.
